before.title: Fermi-Walker transport preserves the metric, and explicit rigid and non-rigid observer congruences
before.statement: (a) Preservation. Let x: I -> A be a C^2 future timelike worldline and let X,Y: I -> V be C^1 Fermi-Walker transported fields along x (def-sr-fermi-walker-transport). Then tau |-> eta(X(tau),Y(tau)) is constant on I; in particular Fermi-Walker transport preserves norms and orthogonality, and the unique Fermi-Walker transported family with initial values a tetrad (E_0(tau_0),...,E_3(tau_0)) with E_0(tau_0) = U(tau_0)/c is an orthonormal tetrad (E_0(tau),...,E_3(tau)) at every tau with E_0(tau) = U(tau)/c (observer-adapted tetrad), by lem-sr-fermi-walker-transport-existence-and-uniqueness. (b) Rindler wedge congruence. In an inertial chart (x^0,x,y,z) consider Phi(theta,rho,y,z) := (rho sinh theta, rho cosh theta, y, z) on (0,inf)xR^3. Then Phi is a smooth bijection onto the right wedge W := {(x^0,x) : x > |x^0|}, with smooth inverse rho = sqrt(x^2 - (x^0)^2), theta = (1/2) log((x + x^0)/(x - x^0)); the pullback of eta is g = -rho^2 d theta^2 + d rho^2 + dy^2 + dz^2; the field n := rho^{-1} partial/partial theta is a future unit timelike field on W whose congruence is Born rigid and irrotational, with acceleration a = nabla_n n = rho^{-1} partial/partial rho, hence eta(a,a) = rho^{-2}; its rest slices theta = const are hyperplanes orthogonal to n with induced metric d rho^2 + dy^2 + dz^2 independent of theta; and the frame (n, partial/partial rho, partial/partial y, partial/partial z) is a tetrad field which is not a coordinate frame, since [n, partial/partial rho] = -(1/rho) n is nonzero (def-lie-bracket-of-smooth-vector-fields). (c) Rigid rotation and failure of global ring simultaneity. Let R > 0 and Omega satisfy Omega R < c. In the inertial chart write a ring point as (x^1,x^2) = (R cos phi, R sin phi) and consider the observer at phi = phi_0 + Omega t (chart time t), with unit tangent n = gamma(1, -(Omega R/c) sin phi, (Omega R/c) cos phi, 0), gamma := (1 - Omega^2 R^2/c^2)^{-1/2}. Then (i) the vorticity of n is nonzero on the ring, so by the Frobenius criterion the rest distribution of this congruence is not integrable: no rest-simultaneity hypersurfaces exist even locally; (ii) in the rotating angular coordinate varphi := phi - Omega t the induced flat metric on the cylinder r = R is -(c^2 - Omega^2R^2)dt^2 + 2Omega R^2 dt dvarphi + R^2 dvarphi^2, the rest-space covector of n is proportional to -(c^2 - Omega^2R^2)dt + Omega R^2 dvarphi, and the integral curves of the rest distribution satisfy dt/dvarphi = Omega R^2/(c^2 - Omega^2R^2); the curve through the event with varphi = 0 and t = 0 therefore returns to the same spatial position after one turn with t = 2pi Omega R^2/(c^2 - Omega^2R^2), which is nonzero when Omega is nonzero: the rest simultaneity does not close up around the ring and no single-valued ring time exists. (d) Bell congruence. Let q: J -> R^3 be C^2 with q(t) = (q_1(t),0,0) and |q_1'(t)| < c, and consider the congruence of translated worldlines x_xi(t) = (c t, q(t) + xi) parametrized by xi in an open subset of R^3, with n = gamma(1, q_1'(t)/c, 0, 0), gamma = (1 - q_1'(t)^2/c^2)^{-1/2}, and unit longitudinal rest vector s = gamma(q_1'(t)/c, 1, 0, 0). A breaking or fracture conclusion about a material rod would additionally require an elasticity model and a failure criterion and is not a kinematic statement.

before.title: Worked Bell-type translated congruence: constant launch-frame separation without Born rigidity
before.statement: Worked computation. In an inertial chart let q(t) = ((1/2)alpha t^2, 0, 0) with alpha > 0, and consider the congruence of translated worldlines x_xi(t) = (ct, q(t) + xi) for xi in an open subset of R^3, defined while |q_1'(t)| = alpha t < c. Then n = gamma(1, alpha t/c, 0, 0) with gamma = (1 - alpha^2t^2/c^2)^{-1/2}, and the unit longitudinal rest vector is s = gamma(alpha t/c, 1, 0, 0). (a) Direct computation gives theta(s,s) = s^a s^b partial_a n_b = (2 + gamma^2 alpha^2t^2/c^2) gamma^3 alpha^2 t/c^3, which is nonzero for every t != 0. Hence the congruence is not Born rigid on any neighbourhood of a time t != 0: the longitudinal expansion does not vanish. (b) Nevertheless, for every fixed chart time t the separation between the member labelled xi_1 and the member labelled xi_2 is |xi_1 - xi_2|, constant in t: the congruence has constant launch-frame separation while failing Born rigidity. before.statement: Let n be a smooth future unit timelike field on a nonempty open subset Omega of A with acceleration a = nabla_n n, rest metric h, expansion theta and vorticity omega, and assume that n is Born rigid, theta = 0 (def-sr-observer-congruence-and-kinematics). (iii) Irrotational case. Suppose theta = omega = 0 on Omega. Its acceleration one-form is a-flat=[k(lambda)/N]d xi, and d(a-flat)=[1/(L_0^2N^2)]d lambda wedge d xi is nowhere zero.
